contentHtml:
New Delhi: Jubilant Draximage Inc., a subsidiary of Jubilant Pharma Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Jubilant Pharmova Limited, has announced an investment of CAD 94.5 million to modernise and expand its facility in Kirkland, Québec, Canada, and increase production capacity across its radiopharmaceutical portfolio.

The investment is specifically aimed at doubling the production capacity of its flagship product, RUBY-FILL. The Government of Canada will provide financial support of CAD 23.8 million for the project.

Jubilant Draximage continues to see strong demand for RUBY-FILL, with its customer base doubling over the past three years. The expansion is expected to help the company meet the increased demand for the product.

Speaking on the announcement, Harsher Singh, CEO of Jubilant Radiopharma business, said, “This investment recognizes Jubilant Radiopharma’s innovation capabilities in Nuclear Medicine and the important role our sector plays in advancing both diagknostic and therapeutic treatments. This project will build our deep capability here in Quebec, create and secure high-value jobs, and ensure a reliable supply of essential radiopharmaceutical products in Canada and around the world.”

Jubilant Radiopharma's portfolio includes diagnostic and therapeutic solutions supporting precision medicine across cardiology, oncology and nuclear medicine.

RUBY-FILL enables the on-site production of Rubidium-82 for cardiac PET imaging, helping clinicians assess coronary artery disease and improve patient care. The company's Technetium-99m (99mTc) diagnostic portfolio supports a broad range of single-photon emission computed tomography (SPECT) imaging procedures. These products play a critical role in disease detection, diagnosis, staging and treatment planning across clinical specialties, including oncology, cardiology and neurology.

In the therapeutic segment, Jubilant's Iodine-131 products have long supported the treatment of thyroid disease, thyroid cancer and neuroblastoma through the targeted delivery of radiation to diseased tissue.

The Kirkland facility is the only site in Canada producing these product categories, according to the company. The investment will support the modernisation and expansion of the facility, including the installation of advanced production equipment, enabling Jubilant Radiopharma to double its manufacturing capacity to meet growing global demand for RUBY-FILL.
